newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity volume surges on agency trade.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity volume surges on agency trade.

text.p: Trading volume in LucasVarity Plc surged after an agency cross trade carried out through brokerage SBC Warburg, market sources said on Tuesday.
The stock was down 3p at 246-1/2 by 1305 GMT in volume of 57 million shares.
No details on the identity of the buyer and seller of the stock were immediately available.
Earlier shares in the Anglo-U.S. automotive engineering group dipped after Lucas and Varity separately announced their last set of results before their recently-announced merger takes effect.
Lucas posted a sharp rise in pre-tax profits to 180.1 million stg from 135.1 million while Varity reported flat operating profits due to the short-term softness in auto markets.
